selectedIdea.angle: Show what the evidence says about osiris.

synthesis.factHandoff: OSIRIS-REx released the capsule toward Earth, diverted away about 20 minutes after release, and continued in space. The capsule landed in Utah after its descent.

narrative.content:
Kern van het verhaal
De capsule landde in Utah, terwijl het moederschip in de ruimte bleef.

Redactionele insteek
Licht dit feit in gewone taal toe.

source:
It landed at the Department of Defense’s Utah Test and Training Range
About 20 minutes after the spacecraft released its sample capsule above Earth’s atmosphere, it fired its engines to divert its trajectory away from Earth.
